thread:
mina: FYI planning an 8-week coding retreat in Reykjavik from 2026-08-02 to 2026-09-26 to focus on the next product sprint. Staying on Redwood payroll. Will the WFH stipend continue and any payroll/tax flags?

maria (People Ops): @mina thanks for the heads up! Quick clarifiers: will you be working full-time for Redwood while there? Any client-facing billing or local engagements that could be invoiced by a local partner?

mina: Full-time for Redwood. No client invoices or local contracts. I'll be in an Airbnb and may use a coworking space occasionally.

owen (Payroll): Iceland is usually okay for short stays but 8 weeks crosses the 30-day internal policy trigger. Our standard approach: suspend recurring home-office stipend for international temporary stays and reimburse actual coworking/hot-desk costs via expense. Also need to check social security implications and payroll reporting.

nora (Tax): Agreed. Iceland has specific rules for temporary work by non-residents; 8 weeks is unlikely to create a corporate PE for advisory/dev work, but we need address + activities to be safe. Please don't sign any local agreements. We'll run a short checklist once you submit the remote form.

kate (Benefits): Health insurance note: our medical carrier covers short business travel but long stays sometimes require top-up travel insurance. For 8 weeks we typically advise purchasing a short-term travel medical policy and expense it if needed. I'll confirm the insurer policy.

lucas (Manager): Team fully supports. Mina — happy to provide a note about the work scope for Tax if that helps.

maria (People Ops): Action items for @mina: 1) Submit remote-location form (select "International temporary") https://go.redwoodinference.com/remote-request 2) Provide exact dates and Reykjavik address 3) Confirm no local payroll or invoicing. We'll run payroll/tax/benefits checks.

mina: Form submitted (address: Skolavorour 12, Reykjavik). Dates above. No local payroll or invoices.

nora (Tax): Received — we'll aim to advise within 3 business days. Possible outcomes: OK to proceed with expense-based coworking reimbursement, or need short local filings if any unexpected flags.

owen (Payroll): Please mark any company equipment you take in AssetTracker and file temporary export if shipping. If you need to ship gear to Iceland, let Payroll know; there may be customs paperwork.

kate (Benefits): I'll check medical carrier and post back. If additional travel medical is needed, we'll provide coding for expense reimbursement.

hr-bot: Reminder: keep receipts for coworking/hotel workspaces and submit via Expenses with code TRAVEL-WORK.

maria (People Ops): Tentative policy treatment: pause recurring WFH stipend, reimburse coworking up to policy weekly cap while abroad. Final confirmation after Tax & Benefits sign-off. We'll update this thread when complete. :white_check_mark:

mina: Thanks everyone 99; appreciate quick turnaround. I'll wait before booking longer stays or flights.

lucas (Manager): Thanks @mina. Ping me if you need time adjustments.
